purpose: Capture one licensed-release reference for subsequent taxonomy method review, not county evidence.

checks.output: Taxonomy reference transport: exact bytes and hash, immutable destination, size caps, truncation, HTTP error/redirect, encoding, HTML, registry purpose and unsafe paths passed. No network requests or acceptance method.

controls: MAIN branch and clean committed worktree
Registered HTTPS endpoint and versioned parameters
Streaming bytes and SHA-256; declared and observed size must agree
100 MiB registered archive cap, within 256 MiB national limit
Unique acquisition directory; preserve partial failures; never overwrite completed receipts
ZIP signature, bounded archive listing and release metadata; no filesystem extraction
Reference-only purpose; no inference or county outcome pathway
limitations: Live capture has not yet run.
Dataset release metadata must establish its actual reuse terms; an older CC-BY-4.0 GBIF mirror is not a substitute.
This validates acquisition integrity, not taxonomy concepts or biological evidence.
